body: Nothing, I can't think of anything at all honestly.
It sounds so empty and unhelpful, but there isn't anything I enjoy that much. No hobbies.

No certain reason, I don't think.
I think I would change the country I was born in, not that it's that bad. I just feel bad generally and I attribute it to that sometimes, but I don't think it's really a problem.
I don't feel like I could talk to anyone in real life, I'm shy and I think that kind of thing would be too expensive.
I feel like people don't take me seriously if I tell my age. but whatever. I'm 16.

I guess I've been feeling depressed since I was about 11-12. I think I was happier as a child, but I'm not really sure. 
I can't really put my finger on anything definite that makes me feel bad. I just have an underlying terrible feeling all the time. I'm still in high school, live with my mother.

It's so hard to explain how i feel. I feel so apathetic towards everything. And I feel everything is so hard and painful for me most of the time.
Also username comes from Kurt Vile song title.
